reason: The S01 hero preview now shows the first three pieces including sold-out ones; the empty state shows only when there are no pieces at all.
S06 now renders the fulfilment status through FulfilmentStatusOptions labels instead of the stored key.
S20 returns nothing while the session is being read and shows a Sign in link to /sign-in when there is no signed-in owner.
Orders now persist itemPieceId, cancel restores stock matched by piece id, and lines whose piece or variant is gone are reported in a warning toast instead of silently skipped.
